Maybe other people can tell the difference, I don't know. I like the idea of better conditions for workers and fewer food miles, but I'll be going back to pink Himalayan salt.
reviews.Title: Has some indissolvable sediment

reviews.Author: Melvin H. Chapman
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on October 3, 2017
reviews.Text: Warning! Volumes have been written about salt and high blood pressure! A noted expert recommends Real Salt, claiming you can use it freely on food without any worries about health issues, yet he includes (probably to protect him from lawsuits) the statement to be frugal with it if you have high blood pressure! It is conflicting statements like this that cause much confusion in the health industry. The best way to find if it is as bad as regular table salt would be to check your blood pressure and then eat a generous amount of the sea salt and then recheck your blood pressure again. If your pressure shows a definite increase, it is no better than regular table salt. Out of curiosity, I asked my family doctor how to correct low blood pressure and he told me to eat some table salt for a temporary fix..
reviews.Title: Test it before using a lot of itd!

reviews.Text: Package arrived on time, contents seems to be as stated, but the outside of package had what looked like either blood or red sauce of some type on a good portion of bag, and pretty well beat up, though thankfully not compromised. Two stars deducted due to the filthy state of packaging...yuck. I'll be thinking twice before ordering from them again.
